project.name: Skyesoft Kalshi BTC 15-Minute Paper Trading
project.objective: Determine whether a repeatable and economically useful edge exists in Kalshi 15-minute Bitcoin price prediction markets before enabling live trading.

verifiedCapabilities: Load Kalshi credentials from Skyesoft environment
Read private RSA key outside public web root
Make authenticated HTTPS requests from GoDaddy

phases.name: Read-Only Kalshi API Layer
phases.objective: Convert the successful authentication test into reusable read-only Skyesoft Kalshi API components.
tasks: Retrieve market open and close times
Preserve raw API responses for development

phases.name: Opening Market Snapshot
phases.objective: Capture the market state at the beginning of each 15-minute BTC prediction cycle.
phases.note: Final schema will be based on actual Kalshi API payloads rather than assumed field names.

phases.name: Intraperiod Observation Capture
phases.objective: Record how BTC and the prediction market evolve during each 15-minute cycle.
purpose: Analyze whether entry at market open is optimal

phases.name: Paper Decision Engine
phases.objective: Generate and permanently record the action that would have been taken using only information available at decision time.
phases.rule: A recorded decision must not be altered based on subsequent market movement or settlement.

phases.name: Paper Settlement and Performance
phases.objective: Settle each simulated position against the actual Kalshi result and calculate performance.

phases.name: Strategy Evaluation
phases.objective: Determine whether the strategy demonstrates a repeatable edge sufficient to justify further development.

phases.name: Strategy Refinement
phases.objective: Use accumulated observations to test whether alternative signals or entry timing improve out-of-sample results.
phases.requirement: Each material strategy change receives a new strategyVersion.

phases.name: Live Trading Decision
phases.objective: Consider controlled live execution only after paper results demonstrate a durable net-positive edge.
requirements: Explicit approval to enable live order capability

tables.name: tblKalshiObservations
tables.purpose: Time-series observations captured during each market.

tables.name: tblKalshiPaperTrades
tables.purpose: Immutable simulated decisions and settlement results.

initialStrategy.purpose: Establish a simple baseline strategy before introducing optimization.
initialStrategy.decisionModel: Compare estimated event probability with executable Kalshi market price and trade only when estimated edge exceeds the required threshold.

nextAction.task: Query the Kalshi API from GoDaddy to discover the active BTC 15-minute market and inspect the actual market payload before designing the database schema.
